content: Tailwind CSS v4 (v4.3.3) uses CSS-first config: no tailwind.config.js required by default, just @import "tailwindcss"; in globals.css plus @tailwindcss/postcss in postcss.config.mjs. create-next-app --tailwind scaffolds this correctly for Next.js 16 projects. Confirmed against tailwindcss.com/docs/guides/nextjs.
